proof_body:
by
  intro K _ _ d s h2 hs hns hd a b
  have hs' : s * s = algebraMap ℚ K (d : ℚ) := by simpa using hs
  have tn : ∀ a b : ℚ, Algebra.trace ℚ K (algebraMap ℚ K a + algebraMap ℚ K b * s) = 2 * a ∧ Algebra.norm ℚ (algebraMap ℚ K a + algebraMap ℚ K b * s) = a ^ 2 - d * b ^ 2 := by
    intro a b
    have hli : LinearIndependent ℚ ![(1 : K), s] := by
      rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
      intro c e hce
      by_cases he : e = 0
      · subst he; simp at hce; exact ⟨hce, rfl⟩
      · exfalso
        apply hns
        refine ⟨-c / e, ?_⟩
        have : (e : ℚ) • s = -(c • (1 : K)) := by
          have := hce; rw [add_comm] at this; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left this
        have he' : algebraMap ℚ K e ≠ 0 := by simpa using he
        rw [map_div₀, map_neg, div_eq_iff he', mul_comm]
        simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using this.symm
    let B : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℚ K := basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank hli (by simp [h2])
    have hB0 : B 0 = 1 := by simp [B]
    have hB1 : B 1 = s := by simp [B]
    let x : K := algebraMap ℚ K a + algebraMap ℚ K b * s
    have e0 : x * B 0 = a • B 0 + b • B 1 := by
      simp [x, hB0, hB1, Algebra.smul_def]
    have e1 : x * B 1 = (b * d) • B 0 + a • B 1 := by
      simp only [x, hB0, hB1, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, add_mul, mul_one]
      rw [mul_assoc, hs']; ring
    have hM : Algebra.leftMulMatrix B x = !![a, b * d; b, a] := by
      ext i j
      rw [Algebra.leftMulMatrix_eq_repr_mul]
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
      · simp [e0]
      · simp [e1]
      · simp [e0]
      · simp [e1]
    constructor
    · change Algebra.trace ℚ K x = _
      rw [Algebra.trace_eq_matrix_trace B, hM, Matrix.trace_fin_two]; simp; ring
    · change Algebra.norm ℚ x = _
      rw [Algebra.norm_eq_matrix_det B, hM, Matrix.det_fin_two]; simp; ring
  have arith1 : ∀ a b : ℚ, (∃ A : ℤ, 2 * a = A) → (∃ c : ℤ, a ^ 2 - d * b ^ 2 = c) → ∃ B : ℤ, 2 * b = B := by
    intro a b ⟨A, hA⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩
    have key : (d : ℚ) * (2 * b) ^ 2 = ((A ^ 2 - 4 * c : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      push_cast; rw [← hA, ← hc]; ring
    set r : ℚ := 2 * b with hr
    have h1 : (d : ℚ) * ((r.num : ℚ) / r.den) ^ 2 = ((A ^ 2 - 4 * c : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      rw [Rat.num_div_den]; exact key
    have hden : (r.den : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast r.den_nz
    have h2' : d * r.num ^ 2 = (A ^ 2 - 4 * c) * (r.den : ℤ) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp at h1
      have h3 : d * r.num ^ 2 = (r.den : ℤ) ^ 2 * (A ^ 2 - 4 * c) := by exact_mod_cast h1
      rw [h3]; ring
    have hcop : IsCoprime ((r.den : ℤ) ^ 2) (r.num ^ 2) := by
      have : IsCoprime (r.num) (r.den : ℤ) := by
        rw [Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]; exact r.reduced
      exact (this.symm.pow)
    have hdvd : (r.den : ℤ) * r.den ∣ d := by
      have : (r.den : ℤ) ^ 2 ∣ d * r.num ^ 2 := ⟨A ^ 2 - 4 * c, by rw [h2']; ring⟩
      rw [← sq]
      exact hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right this
    have hu := hd _ hdvd
    have hden1 : r.den = 1 := by
      have := Int.isUnit_iff.1 hu
      omega
    refine ⟨r.num, ?_⟩
    have := (Rat.num_div_den r).symm
    rw [hden1] at this
    simpa using this
  have arith2 : ∀ A B : ℤ, (4 : ℤ) ∣ A ^ 2 - d * B ^ 2 → (d % 4 = 2 ∨ d % 4 = 3 → 2 ∣ A ∧ 2 ∣ B) ∧ (d % 4 = 1 → (A - B) % 2 = 0) := by
    intro A B h
    have hA : A % 4 = 0 ∨ A % 4 = 1 ∨ A % 4 = 2 ∨ A % 4 = 3 := by omega
    have hB : B % 4 = 0 ∨ B % 4 = 1 ∨ B % 4 = 2 ∨ B % 4 = 3 := by omega
    have hmod : (A ^ 2 - d * B ^ 2) % 4 = 0 := Int.emod_eq_zero_of_dvd h
    constructor
    · intro hd4
      rcases hd4 with hd4 | hd4 <;> rcases hA with hA | hA | hA | hA <;> rcases hB with hB | hB | hB | hB <;>
        simp [pow_two, Int.sub_emod, Int.mul_emod, hA, hB, hd4] at hmod <;> omega
    · intro hd4
      rcases hA with hA | hA | hA | hA <;> rcases hB with hB | hB | hB | hB <;>
        simp [pow_two, Int.sub_emod, Int.mul_emod, hA, hB, hd4] at hmod <;> omega
  have ratint : ∀ (y : K), IsIntegral ℤ y → (∃ n : ℤ, Algebra.norm ℚ y = n) ∧ (∃ m : ℤ, Algebra.trace ℚ K y = m) := by
    intro y hy
    constructor
    · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.1 (Algebra.isIntegral_norm (R := ℤ) ℚ hy)
      exact ⟨n, by simpa using hn.symm⟩
    · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.1 (Algebra.isIntegral_trace (R := ℤ) (L := ℚ) hy)
      exact ⟨n, by simpa using hn.symm⟩
  have forward : IsIntegral ℤ (algebraMap ℚ K a + algebraMap ℚ K b * s) → ∃ A B : ℤ, 2 * a = A ∧ 2 * b = B ∧ (4 : ℤ) ∣ A ^ 2 - d * B ^ 2 := by
    intro hx
    obtain ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, ⟨A, hA⟩⟩ := ratint _ hx
    rw [(tn a b).2] at hc
    rw [(tn a b).1] at hA
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := arith1 a b ⟨A, hA⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨A, B, hA, hB, c, ?_⟩
    have : ((A ^ 2 - d * B ^ 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) = ((4 * c : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      push_cast; rw [← hA, ← hB, ← hc]; ring
    exact_mod_cast this
  have backward : ∀ c A : ℤ, 2 * a = A → a ^ 2 - d * b ^ 2 = c → IsIntegral ℤ (algebraMap ℚ K a + algebraMap ℚ K b * s) := by
    intro c A hA hc
    refine ⟨Polynomial.X ^ 2 + (Polynomial.C (-A) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c), ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add
      exact (Polynomial.degree_linear_le).trans_lt (by norm_num)
    · have hA' : ((A : ℤ) : K) = algebraMap ℚ K (2 * a) := by rw [hA]; simp
      have hc' : ((c : ℤ) : K) = algebraMap ℚ K (a ^ 2 - d * b ^ 2) := by rw [hc]; simp
      simp only [Polynomial.eval₂_add, Polynomial.eval₂_mul, Polynomial.eval₂_pow, Polynomial.eval₂_X, Polynomial.eval₂_C]
      simp only [eq_intCast, Int.cast_neg]
      rw [hA', hc']
      simp only [map_mul, map_sub, map_pow, map_ofNat, map_intCast]
      linear_combination (algebraMap ℚ K b) ^ 2 * hs
  constructor
  · intro hd4
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, h4⟩ := forward hx
      obtain ⟨⟨m, rfl⟩, ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩ := (arith2 A B h4).1 hd4
      refine ⟨m, n, ?_, ?_⟩
      · push_cast at hA; linarith
      · push_cast at hB; linarith
    · rintro ⟨m, n, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact backward (m ^ 2 - d * n ^ 2) (2 * m) (by push_cast; ring) (by push_cast; ring)
  · intro hd4
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, h4⟩ := forward hx
      refine ⟨A, B, (arith2 A B h4).2 hd4, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← hA]; ring
      · rw [← hB]; ring
    · rintro ⟨m, n, hmn, rfl, rfl⟩
      have h4 : (4 : ℤ) ∣ m ^ 2 - d * n ^ 2 := by
        have hm : m % 4 = 0 ∨ m % 4 = 1 ∨ m % 4 = 2 ∨ m % 4 = 3 := by omega
        have hn : n % 4 = 0 ∨ n % 4 = 1 ∨ n % 4 = 2 ∨ n % 4 = 3 := by omega
        apply Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero
        rcases hm with hm | hm | hm | hm <;> rcases hn with hn | hn | hn | hn <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | (simp [pow_two, Int.sub_emod, Int.mul_emod, hm, hn, hd4])
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h4
      refine backward c m (by ring) ?_
      have : ((m ^ 2 - d * n ^ 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) = ((4 * c : ℤ) : ℚ) := by rw [hc]
      push_cast at this
      linear_combination this / 4
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (d : ℤ) (s : K), Module.finrank ℚ K = 2 → s * s = (d : K) → s ∉ Set.range (algebraMap ℚ K) → Squarefree d → ∀ a b : ℚ, (d % 4 = 2 ∨ d % 4 = 3 → (IsIntegral ℤ (algebraMap ℚ K a + algebraMap ℚ K b * s) ↔ ∃ m n : ℤ, a = m ∧ b = n)) ∧ (d % 4 = 1 → (IsIntegral ℤ (algebraMap ℚ K a + algebraMap ℚ K b * s) ↔ ∃ m n : ℤ, (m - n) % 2 = 0 ∧ a = (m : ℚ) / 2 ∧ b = (n : ℚ) / 2))
